function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file at the given path. Returns the file content as text.

path.description: File path to read (absolute or relative to working directory)

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file, creating it if it doesn't exist or overwriting if it does. Parent directories are created automatically.

path.description: File path to write (absolute or relative to working directory)

content.description: The content to write to the file

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace an exact string occurrence in a file with new content. The old_string must match exactly (including whitespace and indentation). Use for precise, surgical edits.

path.description: File path to edit (absolute or relative to working directory)

old_string.description: The exact string to find and replace. Must match exactly one location in the file.

new_string.description: The replacement string. Use empty string to delete the old_string.

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command and return stdout and stderr. Commands have a 30-second timeout.

function.name: grep_search
function.description: Search for a text pattern (regex supported) in files under a directory. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers.

path.description: Directory or file to search in (default: working directory)

include.description: File glob pattern to include, e.g. '*.py' (optional)

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List directory contents. Returns file and directory names, with '/' suffix for directories.

path.description: Directory path to list (default: working directory)

function.name: python
function.description: Execute a Python code snippet and return stdout and stderr. Code runs with the same Python interpreter as llm_engine. Has a 30-second timeout.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch the text content of a web URL. Returns the page body as plain text (HTML tags stripped). Has a 15-second timeout.

function.name: view_image
function.description: View an image file and return its visual content. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP formats. The image will be sent to the vision model for analysis.

path.description: Image file path (absolute or relative to working directory)
